newsitem.title: USA: Nobel's net loss from Fran said $2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nobel's net loss from Fran said $2 mln.

text.p: Nobel Insurance Ltd said on Wednesday it expected its net losses from Hurricane Fran to total $2 million, but the company would still report a profit in the third quarter because of strong operations elsewhere.
Nobel also said in a statement it expected 1,700 claims from the hurricane but that the $2 million estimated loss figure included claim and associated reinsurance.
The company said it had already received 858 actual reported claims in North and South Carolina.
Despite the claims, Nobel said it expected a third-quarter profit due to favorable results in its other divisions and subsidiaries.
Nobel said it would incur the $2 million loss in September.
